Venture Catalysts, with Knowledge Partners Navigate AIF and Khaitan & Co., presents an exclusive webinar on: Accredited Investors in India: Unlocking Exclusive Access, Flexibility & Alpha

In a market where differentiated access drives superior outcomes, Accredited Investors operate with a distinct advantage from entry into private opportunities to greater structural flexibility. This session offers a sharp, practical lens into how that advantage is built and how it can be leveraged.

Key highlights
\\* Strategic importance of accreditation in AIFs
\\* Learnings from Angel Funds leading the shift
\\* End-to-end accreditation process
\\* Compliance benefits & regulatory relaxations

## Frequently Asked Questions

[View all FAQs](https://www.venturecatalysts.in/FAQ)

What benefits do members receive when they join Venture Catalysts angel investing platform?

Members gain access to curated deal flow, expert insights, networking opportunities with seasoned investors, exclusive events, and continuous post-investment support.

How does Venture Catalysts support its members in finding investment opportunities?

Venture Catalyst provides members with screened startup deals, expert due diligence, sector insights, founder interactions, and regular pitch sessions.

Which criterias does Venture Catalysts use to evaluate potential investments for its members?

Startups are evaluated based on market opportunity, team strength, scalability, traction, business model, long-term growth potential and much more

Can members of Venture Catalysts participate in decision-making for investments?

Yes, members actively participate in discussions, evaluations, and investment decisions through structured forums and syndicate participation.

What types of startups does Venture Catalysts typically invest in?

Venture Catalysts invests across multi-stage startups spanning technology, consumer, fintech, healthtech, climate tech, and more.

How can members network with other investors through Venture Catalysts?

Members connect through exclusive events, investor meets, demo days, online forums, and curated networking sessions.
